{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out internal test orders: any order with revenue = '999,999.99'
test_mask = df['revenue'] == '999,999.99'

# Count how many such orders
num_test_orders = test_mask.sum()

# Filter the DataFrame to exclude test orders
df_filtered = df[~test_mask]

# Now clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
df_filtered['revenue_clean'] = df_filtered['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Now filter for completed orders only
df_completed = df_filtered[df_filtered['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = df_completed['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue"}
